description: KentOS point clouds (docs/adr/0207 §6): each cloud's points drawn into a picture of its own (the view's size in device pixels, rgba8unorm premultiplied, transparent where no point is) with a depth32float buffer, the highest point nearest (depth compare less); one draw per octree node with its Draw block at a dynamic offset, its points instances of a six-vertex quad. The styled module's cloud pipeline (styled.layout.json, version 7) then shows the picture over the cloud's plan. The web's WebGPU backend builds the same pipeline from this file; its WebGL2 twin is apps/web/src/render/webgl2/pointShaders.ts.
